confirm.title: Set up {name}
confirm.description: Add this Voltcraft SEM6000 / SPB012BLE and authenticate with its four-digit device PIN?

data_description.pin: The factory default is 0000. The value is masked in the form.

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must contain exactly four decimal digits.

abort.no_devices_found: No connectable Voltcraft device was found.

menu_options.login_pin: Set login PIN for Home Assistant

menu_options.timer_at: Start timer for a date and time

login_pin.title: Login PIN used by Home Assistant
login_pin.description: Set the PIN Home Assistant uses to log in to the plug. This does not change the PIN on the plug. Use this only when the plug PIN was changed outside Home Assistant and the connection therefore fails.

data_description.pin: The PIN currently stored in Home Assistant is not shown for security reasons.

change_pin.title: Change PIN on the plug
change_pin.description: The plug may change its PIN without returning an acknowledgement. Home Assistant therefore reconnects with the new PIN and stores it only after that login succeeds.

reset_pin.title: Reset plug PIN
reset_pin.description: Reset the PIN stored on the plug to the factory default 0000. Home Assistant verifies the result through a fresh login.

data.confirm: I understand and want to reset the PIN

timer_delay.title: Start timer after a duration
timer_delay.description: Set the switching action and duration explicitly.

data_description.duration: Enter the duration as days, hours, minutes and seconds.

timer_at.title: Start timer for a date and time
timer_at.description: Set the switching action, date and time explicitly.

timer_stop.title: Stop active timer
timer_stop.description: Submit this form to stop the timer currently stored on the plug.

schedule_add.title: Add schedule
schedule_add.description: Create a one-time or repeating schedule on the plug.

data_description.date: Used for a one-time schedule. For a repeating weekday schedule, the plug ignores the date.
data_description.weekdays: Leave empty for a one-time schedule. Select one or more weekdays for a repeating schedule.

schedule_edit.title: Edit schedule
schedule_edit.description: Change the selected schedule stored on the plug.

data_description.date: Used for a one-time schedule. For a repeating weekday schedule, the plug ignores the date.
data_description.weekdays: Leave empty for a one-time schedule. Select one or more weekdays for a repeating schedule.

schedule_remove.title: Remove schedule
schedule_remove.description: Permanently remove the selected schedule from the plug.

data.confirm: I understand and want to remove this schedule

reset_consumption.title: Reset device consumption data
reset_consumption.description: This resets the consumption history and total energy stored in the plug. Home Assistant history that has already been recorded is not deleted.

data.confirm: I understand that the device data will be reset

factory_reset.title: Factory-reset the plug
factory_reset.description: This resets device settings and the PIN. Home Assistant will verify the factory PIN 0000 after the command. Use only with a non-critical load.

data.confirm: I understand and want to factory-reset the plug

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must contain exactly four decimal digits.
error.pin_mismatch: The two PIN entries do not match.
error.invalid_duration: The duration must be between one second and 365 days.
error.confirmation_required: Enable the confirmation field before continuing.
error.invalid_datetime: The selected date or time is invalid.

abort.pin_changed: The plug accepted the new PIN and Home Assistant verified it through a fresh login.
abort.pin_reset: The plug PIN was reset to 0000 and verified.
abort.timer_started: The timer was stored on the plug.
abort.schedule_saved: The schedule was stored on the plug.
abort.schedule_removed: The schedule was removed from the plug.
abort.no_schedules: The plug currently reports no schedules that can be edited or removed.
abort.schedule_load_failed: The schedules could not be loaded: {error}
abort.consumption_reset: The consumption data stored on the plug was reset.
abort.factory_reset: The factory reset completed and the default PIN 0000 was verified.
